WITH step_s1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.geom AS geom, NULL::double precision AS value, f.name::text AS name, f.city::text AS city, f.state::text AS state, NULL::text AS county, f.address::text AS address, NULL::text AS type, NULL::text AS status FROM d968f276355a41d1bd1451be6ee4dbac_fire_stations f WHERE (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_geom p WHERE p.kind = 'place' AND (lower(p.name) = lower($1) OR lower(p.name) LIKE lower($1) || ', %')) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_geom p WHERE p.kind = 'place' AND (lower(p.name) = lower($1) OR lower(p.name) LIKE lower($1) || ', %') AND p.geom && f.geom AND ST_Intersects(p.geom, f.geom)) ELSE f.city ILIKE $1 END)),
     step_s2 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT f.geom AS geom, NULL::double precision AS value, f.name::text AS name, f.city::text AS city, f.state::text AS state, NULL::text AS county, f.address::text AS address, NULL::text AS type, NULL::text AS status FROM d968f276355a41d1bd1451be6ee4dbac_fire_stations f),
     step_s3 AS (WITH net_r AS (SELECT coalesce((SELECT rr.region FROM road_region rr JOIN (SELECT geom FROM step_s2) a ON a.geom && rr.bbox GROUP BY rr.region ORDER BY count(*) DESC, rr.region LIMIT 1), road_region_for((SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_Extent(geom), 4326)::geometry FROM (SELECT geom FROM step_s2) e))) AS region), net_box AS (SELECT rr.bbox FROM road_region rr, net_r WHERE rr.region = net_r.region), net_src AS (SELECT DISTINCT (SELECT v.id FROM road_vertex v WHERE v.region = net_r.region AND v.drive_cc ORDER BY v.geom::geography <-> (b.geom)::geography LIMIT 1) AS node FROM (SELECT geom FROM step_s1) b, net_r, road_region rr WHERE rr.region = net_r.region AND b.geom && rr.bbox), net_pts AS (SELECT a.*, (SELECT v.id FROM road_vertex v WHERE v.region = net_r.region AND v.drive_cc ORDER BY v.geom::geography <-> (a.geom)::geography LIMIT 1) AS node FROM step_s2 a, net_r, net_box WHERE a.geom && net_box.bbox), net_cost AS (SELECT d.end_vid AS node, d.agg_cost FROM net_r CROSS JOIN LATERAL pgr_dijkstraCost(format($3::text, net_r.region, ARRAY(SELECT node FROM net_src WHERE node IS NOT NULL)::text), 0::bigint, ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT node FROM (SELECT node FROM net_pts) t WHERE node IS NOT NULL), directed => true) d) SELECT p.geom, r.agg_cost / $4::float8 AS value, p.name, p.city, p.state, p.county, p.address, p.type, p.status FROM net_pts p LEFT JOIN net_cost r ON r.node = p.node WHERE r.agg_cost <= $2::float8)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(r.geom) AS geometry, r.value AS drive_minutes_to_nearest, r.name, r.city, r.state, r.address
FROM step_s3 r
ORDER BY r.value ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3000
